question: Does a forced single deferred hole followed by constrained infill improve bounded composition over one-pass generation or an equally two-pass unrestricted revision?
seed_policy: one deterministic seed per authored case, shared across arms and both calls

arms.full-revision: the same direct call followed by one unrestricted bounded revision call
arms.deferred-infill: one forced-single-hole draft call followed by one hole-only infill call; runtime performs literal replacement

interpretation_boundary: This tests an explicit deferred-commitment protocol. It does not measure or prove internal model uncertainty.
